mapper.select: SELECT a.name, a.data FROM powerful_api a where a.owner = #{owner}
mapper.update: UPDATE powerful_api set data = #{data}, updated_date = NOW() WHERE name = #{name} and owner = #{owner}
mapper.select: select c.leftword, SUM(c.cnt) cnt, SUM(c.`space`) space from plm_ultron_sentence s, plm_ultron_context uc, plm_context c where s.n = uc.sentence and uc.context = c.n and s.target is not null group by c.leftword
select w.n from llm_word w, plm_context c where w.n = c.rightword and c.cnt > 0 and w.`type` = '무엇' and CHAR_LENGTH(w.word) = 1 group by w.n having COUNT(w.n) > 2
